title: Claude built a Jira alternative, and my spec forgot customers with duplicate bugs #shorts
description:
Free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/bug-tracker?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=bug-tracker

Claude built a bug tracker, a Jira alternative with one owner per bug, fix targets by severity, duplicates linked to one bug and a public report form, from one written spec: all 31 acceptance checks passed, along with 56 automated tests. The test build exposed 5 gaps in the spec, including what to tell a customer whose report is a duplicate (now: nothing until the real bug is verified), and every one is fixed; production sign-in, real email sending and hosting were not tested.

Jira's Free plan is $0 for up to 10 users (everyone is an admin, 100 emails a day); Standard billed yearly is $950 a year for 1 to 10 users (atlassian.com/software/jira/pricing and atlassian.com/licensing/jira, checked November 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
